subject: rt-dy
title: RT.DYM.------CULT.INFO.B.
description: Chart on book p. 72 (WAM-14). RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) is the partner. The title names RT-DYM (reality dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: EXT-DYM (extended dynamics), INFO-INTR (information interpretation) and T-P (time presence). From EXT-DYM: LG-EXT (logical extension). From INFO-INTR: POL-DY (political dynamics). From T-P: TR-DEF (trans-definition). From LG-EXT: MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis). From POL-DY: MOT-DY.
